purpose: Re-check of the species that have no IUCN assessment, for verified-4.0 (team-lead request 2026-10-04 to check every '미확인' item). The IUCN site search index of Red List 2026-1 was queried by phrase for each name; 2026-2 is scheduled for 19 November 2026. Read only by configs that name this file.
also_checked: Korean national red data books vols 1-12 (no volume for seaweeds, crustaceans, ascidians or marine fishes); Japan Ministry of the Environment red lists (algae 2020, marine 2017) and the Fisheries Agency rarity evaluation 2017 (94 species); China, Taiwan, Russian Federation and Vietnam lists. Only 넙치 and 대구 have a listed evaluation (Fisheries Agency 'ランク外'), used through the range-state route; the others have none.

iucn_redlist_recheck.provider: IUCN Red List of Threatened Species
iucn_redlist_recheck.title: Site search of Red List assessments (version 2026-1)
iucn_redlist_recheck.license: IUCN terms of use; search results only, no assessment text
